title: Chelsea Grin announces Skin Deep... and a new album?
contentHtml:
Chelsea Grin a deathcore band from Salt Lake City, UT have announced their new single titled ‘Skin Deep’ which will be available tomorrow December 11th but can already be found on sites such as YouTube and Zippyshare. ‘Skin Deep’ is a brutal heavy hitter that blows their last album “Ashes to Ashes” out of the water already. Chelsea Grin wasn’t done there the band then proceeded to tweet “Skin Deep isn’t the only news coming..” with an attachment of what appears to be new album artwork.
I will be sure to keep everyone posted on announcements and other things Chelsea Grin, listen to the single now on YouTube and if you like it make the purchase on iTunes tomorrow, stay metal my friends.

​
